description: On the green cloth in front of you are piles of colorful beads, a finished purple-and-white looped necklace, and a black tape dispenser. The left hand holds a short piece of dark string near the center while the right hand reaches to the small purple-and-white bead strip, pinches a bead, and guides it onto the string, then both hands pull the string upward and slightly apart to slide and settle the bead into place.
